law_name: Law No. 2022-59 of 16 December 2022 on the Protection of Personal Data (amended by Law No. 2023-31 of 4 July 2023 and Ordinances 2024-16 and 2024-29)
scope: Data subjects (natural persons) whose personal data are processed in Niger (unconfirmed)
applies_to: Public and private controllers and processors (unconfirmed)
key_requirements: Data-subject rights: access, rectification/erasure, objection and opposition to direct marketing; controllers report annually to HAPDP on data kept beyond the period HAPDP sets (art. 64) (unconfirmed)
data_categories: Personal data; sensitive data (e.g. health, religion, political affiliation)
retention_period: Period fixed by HAPDP; controller reports annually on data kept beyond it (art. 64 per DLA Piper) (unconfirmed)
enforcement_authority: High Authority for the Protection of Personal Data (HAPDP), independent administrative authority attached to the Presidency; 11 members (art. 7 as amended)
notes: Replaced Law No. 2017-28; Law 2023-31 amended arts 6, 7, 14, 23, 24 and 111; no official English translation; HAPDP site hapdp.ne reportedly hosts the text but was not verified; promulgation and entry-into-force dates not found; effective_date not found: the enactment date is used
